title: Fix the firstmate study's Reopened state: not terminal, back to Queued
summary: The firstmate study wrongly marks 'reopened' as terminal-success and says Done and Reopened both "end the task". Per the code, teardown reopens the backlog item and it returns to Queued. I'll correct model.json and intro.json (the audience is the reader of the study page and the post-landing source check) so the check passes.

defaults_applied.how: The final criterion requires the source check to pass on the reopened state.
Fixes both the model and the intro text that repeat the wrong claim.
One focused edit to two study files.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The task's 'source check' is the study validation run after landing; I did not read its code, so the exact rule (state kind vs claim text) is unconfirmed.
I did not read bin/fm-teardown.sh in the pinned source, so lines 3894-3896 are taken from the request. If the claims need a new cited source for the Queued return, claims.json changes too.
The model may require non-terminal states to have an outgoing transition, so a Reopened->Queued transition may be needed in model.json.

acceptance_criteria.text: In studies/firstmate-work-handling/model.json the 'reopened' state no longer has kind 'terminal-success'; it is a non-terminal kind (e.g. waiting), or the item returns to 'queued', consistent with bin/fm-teardown.sh sending the backlog row back to Queued.

studies/firstmate-work-handling/intro.json 'states' lead-in no longer says Done and Reopened both carry 'ends the task'. It says only Done ends the task, and that Reopened sends the item back to Queued for the captain's answer. Grep for 'ends the task' confirms.
The 'reopened' glossary definition in intro.json, and any transition out of Reopened added to model.json, match the cited claims c23-c25 and the Queued return, with no new uncited claims.

Run cargo test (the study/record validation tests over studies/) and cargo clippy: they pass with the edited study files. The source check on the study page for the reopened state passes, as shown in the recorded check output.

out_of_scope: Changing the firstmate source code or the pinned commit
urgent_reason: Cuts repeated refusals of the study page, three today, by the post-landing source check.
